# Obsidian MD Opener

**笔记都在资源管理器里找到了，为什么还要进 Obsidian 再找一遍？**

我经常用 Obsidian 看散落在桌面和项目里的 Markdown。第一版打开器替我建好了仓库，双击笔记就能省掉手动建库和找文件的步骤。可碰上一个有几千个构建文件的项目，我只想看一篇笔记，等了 20 分钟还没打开。

现在，在 Windows 资源管理器里双击那篇 `.md` 就行。项目里的文件太多，或检查目录已花了 **1.2 秒**，打开器会优先用轻量仓库打开笔记和能找到的附件。按下保存，改的还是原文件。下次打开另一个本机仓库，快捷键、外观和常用插件设置也会跟过去。

**开始使用**　安装并启动一次 Obsidian，把打开器放在固定文件夹，设为 `.md` 的默认应用。

[下载 Windows 打开器](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/releases/latest/download/ObsidianMdOpener.exe) · [中文使用说明](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_ch.md)

## English

**You already found the note in File Explorer. Why hunt for it again in Obsidian?**

I built this opener because I was tired of finding a Markdown file, adding its folder as a vault, then looking for the same note all over again. My first version handled the vault setup for me. Then I tried it on a project with thousands of build files. Twenty minutes later, I was still waiting to read one note.

Now I just double-click the `.md` file in Windows Explorer. If the project has too many files or the folder check takes **1.2 seconds**, the opener tries a lightweight vault with the note and any attachments it can find. Save an edit and it goes straight into the original file. Open a different vault on the same PC and your hotkeys, appearance, and common plugin settings come with you.

**Get started.** Install and launch Obsidian once. Keep the opener in a permanent folder and set it as the default app for `.md` files.

[Download for Windows](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/releases/latest/download/ObsidianMdOpener.exe) · [English guide](https://github.com/95490164/Obsidian-MD-Opener/blob/main/readme_en.md)
